purpose: Per-program and per-rail evidence for publisher eligibility and payout feasibility from Algeria. Facts only, each with sources and a check date. Anything not stated by a source is UNKNOWN. Read by affiliate/eligibility_matrix.py; never a claim of approval or income.

paypal.summary: PayPal's Algeria user agreement allows receiving payments, with conditions (a linked US bank account or Visa card for withdrawal, holds of up to 30 days, fees). Not blocked, not frictionless.
paypal.recheck_2026-10-22: Re-fetch of the agreement page returned only its title (truncated); the earlier same-day OBSERVED extract in reports/PAYPAL_ALGERIA_EVIDENCE_2026-10-22.md stands.

paypal_payouts_api.summary: PayPal Payouts supported-features list does not include DZ. Networks paying through Payouts may fail for DZ accounts.

stripe.summary: Stripe is not offered to accounts in Algeria, so PartnerStack's Stripe payout option does not apply.

payoneer.summary: Awin points publishers to Payoneer's capabilities map and does not confirm Algeria. Country-level receive eligibility unconfirmed.

impact_wire_dzd.summary: Platform level only. impact.com lists DZD under 'Wire supported currencies' with Algeria as a supported bank-account location (not in ACH or PayPal lists). Wire fee is 'currency-specific' (amount UNKNOWN), 3-5 business days after the paystub clears, $10 minimum, all payments need SWIFT plus account number or IBAN, bank details are verified by impact.com, and the account currency cannot be changed after setup. Maintenance fee ($10/month direct invoicing) if impact.com cannot pay for 6 months. Account-level (founder's bank, verification) is UNKNOWN.

systeme_wire.summary: systeme.io wire payouts require an IBAN and an 11-character SWIFT code, and are only selectable after the first affiliate sale. Algeria is not in the IBAN standard's main list: iban.com lists DZ only under 'Partial IBAN Countries (Experimental)' (24 chars; another source says 26). Whether systeme.io's form accepts a DZ account, and whether the founder's bank provides an IBAN, is UNKNOWN until tried in the account.

CO-systeme-affiliate.eligibility_quote: Anyone can join ... There are no conditions to join our affiliate program.
CO-systeme-affiliate.account_observed: SYSTEME_AFFILIATE_ID is configured in .env (value never read into reports). Account standing UNVERIFIED.
CO-systeme-affiliate.payout_note: PayPal receiving in Algeria is conditional; wire needs IBAN/SWIFT and a first sale. No payout has been attempted.

agreement.commission: 60% per new customer; rate may be changed via the Affiliate Tool
agreement.attribution: lead-based, lifetime; lost if the lead buys through another affiliate's link on a payment page; no referral without a free signup
agreement.eligibility: over 18; compensation may be limited by Irish law or the affiliate's local law; US export rules may apply
agreement.commission_void_if: refund requested within 30 days; customer not retained for 30 days; self-referral or affiliated party
promotion_rules: no deceptive, misleading, illegal or unethical marketing
systeme.io trademarks only in connection with the program
no competitor trademarks in promotion of systeme.io
may not imply systeme.io endorses the affiliate
agreement.disclosure: not specified in the agreement (local law and FTC-style disclosure still applied by us)
agreement.taxes: affiliate pays all taxes and fees, including bank fees

CO-n8n-affiliate.payout_note: n8n's affiliate FAQ requires a PayPal account; PartnerStack's Stripe option does not apply in Algeria. EUR 100 minimum.

CO-aweber-affiliate.payout_note: PayPal (USD) only; $50 minimum for non-US referrers.

CO-siteground-affiliate.payout_note: PayPal for low volume; wire only for high volume.

CO-brevo-affiliate.payout_note: Via PartnerStack: PayPal (conditional in Algeria) or Stripe (unavailable in Algeria).

CO-digitalocean-affiliate.payout_note: Awin pays international publishers through Payoneer; Awin does not confirm Algeria. Application-based (Awin).

CO-envato-affiliate.network: impact.com (Elements, Market and Placeit programs; affiliates need an impact.com account; manual review by Envato's partnerships team)
CO-envato-affiliate.payout_note: Paid through impact.com, whose wire rail lists DZD/Algeria. Program acceptance and the founder's account are unverified. Envato's help page returned 403 to a direct fetch; network facts come from its search excerpt.

CO-canva-affiliate.network: impact.com (Canva's own affiliate help page); entry now reported (third-party) to be the Canvassador program, applications opened only periodically
CO-canva-affiliate.payout_note: Same impact.com rail as Envato, but the program is reported closed to new applicants most of the time (UNVERIFIED).

impact_account.signup: Partner account: email, name, mobile verification, country/timezone/currency (pre-filled from IP, editable), approval of the Partner Program Agreement. Free-to-join is stated only by third parties (UNKNOWN on official pages).
impact_account.approval: Two levels: impact.com reviews the marketplace application after the checklist is complete; then each brand approves the partner separately.
